stem: Two cultivars have similar yield potential, but one reliably finishes three weeks earlier in the local climate. Which may be more resilient where autumn weather deteriorates quickly?
choices: The earlier-finishing cultivar may reduce late-season exposure risk if quality and other objectives remain acceptable
The later cultivar is always superior
Finish timing has no risk value
rationale: Earlier completion can be a useful risk-management trait when late-season weather becomes unfavorable.
